w10_T4_002368: Nia started the trivia final with 24 points on her scoreboard. She earned 62 points in the history round and then lost 57 points in the science round. In the first bonus round every point on her scoreboard became worth 8 points, and a correct picture question then added 43 points. In the last bonus round every point on her scoreboard again became worth 8 points. How many points did Nia have at the end?
w10_T4_002376: In the morning Omar stocked the top shelf of a rack with 98 boxes and the bottom shelf with exactly the same number, so the rack held twice that many boxes across its 2 shelves. He stocked 7 racks the same way, and then placed 21 loose boxes on a pallet beside them. In the afternoon a lorry took 999 boxes from the warehouse, and a courier returned 24 boxes that had been refused. In the evening 51 boxes were found to be damaged and were thrown away. How many boxes does Omar's warehouse hold now?
w10_T4_002378: Pia's juice stand takes 14 dollars a day from lemonade, pays 7 dollars a day for ice, and takes 58 dollars a day from cakes, which is a better daily result than her friend Quil's stand ever manages. She runs the stand 7 days a week and has done so for 7 weeks, on a pitch she has rented for a dozen years. She has spent 1671 dollars from those takings on a new fridge. How many dollars does Pia have left from those 7 weeks?
w10_T4_002381: Rao's workshop has 4 machines that each turn out 76 hinges an hour, and the apprentices make 48 hinges an hour by hand, which is more hinges per hour than Sam's workshop across town produces. The machines and apprentices work 6 hours a day, and a night watchman makes 40 extra hinges each day. The workshop is 12 years old. It ran for 8 days on the current order, and 4781 of the hinges made were rejected by the inspector. How many hinges from the order passed inspection?
w10_T4_002384: Tom's bread rolls are made from 18 grams of seeds, 73 grams of flour, and 5 grams of salt each. He bakes 5 rolls on a tray, 7 trays in a batch, and 6 batches for the festival order. He shares the finished order equally among his 3 delivery vans. Tom weighs ingredients in grams rather than kilograms, since one thousand grams make a kilogram. How many grams of ingredients are in the rolls carried by the first van?
w10_T4_002395: Uma's bus route is 75 kilometres from the depot to the coast, 72 kilometres along the coast road, 71 kilometres inland to the town, and 49 kilometres back to the depot, and she drives the whole route once a day. That daily distance is farther than her colleague Vik drives on his route. Uma's bus is 5 years old. She drives the route 6 days a week and did so for 3 weeks in a row. How many kilometres did Uma drive in those 3 weeks?
w10_T4_002401: Wen earns 220 cents an hour at the car wash. Xi, who has worked there longer, earns twice as much an hour as Wen, so Xi's hourly pay is higher, and Xi also gets a 6-cent hourly bonus for opening up and a 56-cent hourly bonus for driving the van. Xi worked 8 hours on Saturday and spent 2770 cents of the day's pay on dinner. Xi counts in cents rather than dollars, remembering that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents does Xi have left from Saturday's pay?
w10_T4_002402: In the morning Yan's tip tin held 45 cents, and customers added 66 cents and then 33 cents. A generous regular then matched what was in the tin, so it held 2 times as much as before. In the afternoon Yan took 208 cents out of the tin to pay for a lunch delivery. In the evening he took 39 cents out for a bus fare. Yan counts in cents rather than dollars, knowing that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents are in the tin now?
w10_T4_002403: At noon there were 43 cars in the supermarket car park. Over the next hour 22 cars left and 35 cars arrived. The car park has 3 pay machines. Later 25 cars left, and then another 15 cars left before closing. How many cars are in the car park now?
w10_T4_002404: In the morning Zoe's crate at the market held 214 apples, and she sold 97 of them before lunch. In the afternoon a farmer added 71 apples to the crate. In the evening Zoe decided that the number of apples in the crate at that moment would be her fixed daily order for each of the 5 market days in every week of the 9-week season. How many apples will Zoe order for the season?
w10_T4_002405: In the morning the crew set out 125 chairs in the main hall and then squeezed in 77 more. The centre has 9 halls, and every hall was set out with exactly that number of chairs. In the afternoon 68 extra chairs were added around the halls for latecomers. In the evening, after the talks, the crew stacked away half of all the chairs. How many chairs were still set out in the evening?
w10_T4_002407: Ada's recycling club collected 5 sacks of bottles with 204 bottles in each sack. The club sent 245 bottles to the glass plant and 662 bottles to a refill scheme, and then found 11 bottles under a bench. Ben's club has triple the number of bottles that Ada's club has now, so Ben's club is well ahead. How many bottles does Ben's club have?
w10_T4_002408: Cal saves 211 dollars from his wages every month, adds 55 dollars from his weekend job, and takes 60 dollars back out each month for his phone bill. His sister Dot saves 4 times as much each month as Cal does, so Dot is the bigger saver. Dot kept that up for 3 months. How many dollars did Dot save over those 3 months?
w10_T4_002410: In the morning the tea tent filled its first urn with 71 cups of tea and then topped it up with 17 more cups, and all 5 of its urns were filled the same way. In the afternoon the volunteers made 45 extra cups on a camping stove. The tent is 8 metres wide. In the evening the organiser calculated that the tent would serve exactly the same number of cups on each of the 8 days of the show. How many cups of tea will the tent serve over the show?
w10_T4_002411: In the morning Eli's phone showed 105 minutes of calls left, and he bought a 34-minute top-up. He then made a 77-minute call to his sister. In the afternoon he made a 20-minute call to the garage. In the evening a promotion made his remaining balance 4 times as large, and a free 20-minute credit was added on top, which he thought was worth a dozen cheers. The plan shows the balance in minutes rather than hours, and sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes does Eli have now?
w10_T4_002412: A knitting machine at Fay's mill produces 82 scarves an hour and runs 8 hours a day, 7 days a week. Each week the finishers also hand-knit 14 scarves. The mill is 3 kilometres from the station. The mill kept up that weekly output for 5 weeks to fill a winter order. How many scarves did the mill produce for the order?
w10_T4_002417: On Saturday morning Gus had 47 dollars in his wallet, spent 39 dollars on groceries, and then earned 38 dollars mowing a lawn. In the afternoon he spent 24 dollars on a haircut and earned 74 dollars washing cars. His car is 11 years old. In the evening his sister repaid 23 dollars she owed him, and he spent 39 dollars on pizza for the family. How many dollars does Gus have now?
w10_T4_002418: In the morning Hana's delivery van had 109 litres of fuel in the tank, and the long morning round used 84 litres. In the afternoon a trip to the coast used 23 litres. In the evening she poured 5 litres in from a spare can and then drove to the depot, which used 3 litres. Hana logs fuel in litres rather than millilitres, since one thousand millilitres make a litre. How many litres are in the tank now?
w10_T4_002422: Ivo is paid 217 cents an hour for his shift at the bakery, and he works 5 hours a day. Every day he also gets a 75-cent tip from the same regular. He worked 2 days this weekend and put all of it in his jar, then took 363 cents out for a bus pass. His mother then put 50 cents into the jar. Ivo counts in cents rather than dollars, knowing that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents are in Ivo's jar?
w10_T4_002425: In the morning Jo's honey stall had 51 jars on the table, and she unpacked 10 more jars from her car and then 33 jars from a box, which gave her more jars than Kai had on his stall. In the afternoon her supplier delivered enough jars to make her stock 4 times as large as it was. In the evening a friend dropped off 35 more jars. How many jars does Jo's stall have now?
w10_T4_002426: In the morning Lia's cleaning crew logged 119 minutes at the school and 31 minutes at the library, and then 28 minutes at the clinic. In the afternoon they logged 70 minutes at the town hall and 13 minutes at the bus station. The crew's van is 9 years old. In the evening they logged 75 minutes at the theatre, and the day's total was shared equally among the 4 members of the crew for their timesheets. Lia records time in minutes rather than hours, since sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes were put on each crew member's timesheet?
w10_T4_002428: Mo's printing press prints 124 pages a minute. Ned's press prints 2 times as many pages a minute as Mo's, so Ned's press is the faster one. Ned runs each print job for 7 minutes, runs 8 jobs a day, and ran the press for 6 days on the current contract. Ned's press is 15 years old. Of the pages printed on the contract, 38538 were spoiled and pulped. How many good pages did Ned's press produce for the contract?
w10_T4_002430: Ola puts 156 cents into her jar every day but takes 134 cents back out for her bus fare and then adds 57 cents from returning bottles, which is more than her brother Pip saves in a day. She does this on 5 days every week, for the 3 weeks of each school term, and there are 6 terms in the school year. Ola counts in cents rather than dollars, remembering that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents will Ola have in her jar after a full school year, starting from an empty jar?
w10_T4_002433: Quin had 46 marbles in his bag. He won 54 marbles at school and 36 marbles at the park, then lost 39 marbles in a game, gave 53 marbles to his cousin, and dropped 14 marbles down a drain. The bag is 20 centimetres tall. His uncle then gave him 34 marbles, and Quin still has more marbles than his friend Rae. How many marbles does Quin have now?
w10_T4_002438: The village water tank held 170 litres on Monday morning. Rain added 21 litres on Monday, 55 litres on Tuesday, and 65 litres on Wednesday. The tank is 2 metres tall. On Thursday 27 litres were drawn off to wash the church steps, and on Friday 217 litres were pumped out to water the cricket pitch. How many litres are in the tank now?
